reported.title: No debounce: every bounce edge toggles the lamp
reported.description: The loop reads D6 and calls toggleArmed() on every HIGH-to-LOW transition (lines 52-58) with no settle window, so each contact bounce is counted as a separate press. The measured evidence shows 4 toggles per press in the bounce scenario ([4, 4, 4, 4]) and 3 per press in the rapid-press scenario, far exceeding the required exactly-one toggle. The 50 ms settle window required by the spec is never implemented, and spurious toggles with no press (e.g. at 1.40 s) confirm raw chatter is being acted on. 4 of 4 press(es) did not toggle D9 exactly once; toggle counts per press were [4, 4, 4, 4]. D9 also toggled 12 time(s) with no press to explain it, first at 1.40 s.

judge_input.spec:
- Shop estop pushbutton on D6 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); machine-armed indicator on D9.
- Each settled press toggles D9 exactly once within 150 ms; release must not toggle.
- Bounce bursts up to 22 ms must not produce more than one toggle per physical press.
- Use a 50 ms settle window before accepting a press.
- Print `shop armed=<0|1> presses=<n>` every 1200 ms.
- Unpressed idle level is HIGH on D6.
